title: Pair of scissors with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Scissors with smiling face, bright colours, no dark outlines -->
  <!-- Left blade -->
  <polygon points='12,20 46,45 41,51 8,29' fill='#d8e6f2' stroke='#a9c2d9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='12,20 46,45 41,51 8,29' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- Right blade -->
  <polygon points='88,20 54,45 59,51 92,29' fill='#bcd6ea' stroke='#8fb0cc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='88,20 54,45 59,51 92,29' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='5' fill='#ffd166' stroke='#e0a800' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='2' fill='#7a5900' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Left handle (loop) -->
  <path d='M41,51 C30,60 22,72 26,84 C30,94 44,94 48,84 C51,75 49,65 46,57' fill='none' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M41,51 C30,60 22,72 26,84 C30,94 44,94 48,84 C51,75 49,65 46,57' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right handle (loop) -->
  <path d='M59,51 C70,60 78,72 74,84 C70,94 56,94 52,84 C49,75 51,65 54,57' fill='none' stroke='#4dd4ac' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M59,51 C70,60 78,72 74,84 C70,94 56,94 52,84 C49,75 51,65 54,57' fill='none' stroke='#8ff0d4' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Face on left blade: eyes -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='32' r='3' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <circle cx='19' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M22,40 Q30,48 38,42' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a6a' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
